name: VegaDuta - call an agent from n8n

nodes.name: Call VegaDuta agent
nodes.notes: POST /v1/chat/completions on the VegaDuta OpenAI-compatible surface. Requires OPENAI_COMPAT_ENABLED=true on the core deployment. 'model' is an agent id (UUID) or the agent's exact name - GET /v1/models lists them. Bearer token: a platform JWT or a vmcp_ grant key. Create an n8n 'Header Auth' credential with Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <token>.
